messages:
maya: Heads up — customer asks for hardened audit exports + customer-controlled keys. Need to align scope for Dedicated/Private. Quick sync?
noah: Can you paste the ask? Is this customer-managed keys + immutability or just stronger KMS controls? :eyes:
maya: They want: customer-managed KMS for export encryption and signing, immutable (WORM) audit exports for 7 years, ability to trigger emergency on-demand export, signed manifest for each export, and export SLA (customer asked <4h for a full export).
chris: SLA of <4h for full archive is ambitious. Today our nightly export pipeline produces daily archives; packaging + signing can add 1-2h depending on queue length. Need priority queue and parallel packagers for on-demand.
sara: From compliance: must support WORM + legal_hold toggle. Also retention enforcement server-side (can't rely on customer S3 ACLs).
deploy-bot: INF Ticket created: INF-4927 export-priority-queue (assigned to eng-infra) :white_check_mark:
maya: @chris can you break down infra vs product scope? Need clear launch criteria to take to prioritization.
chris: Product scope: API endpoints (request export, check status), signed manifest + audit metadata, console flags for immutability and legal_hold.
chris: Infra scope: priority export queue, parallel packaging workers, per-tenant export tokens, export encryption pipeline that integrates with external KMS, export observability (latency/failure).
noah: KMS notes: support CMEK (customer-managed keys) where we only store wrapped keys. We must implement handshake (key-wrapping with customer's KMS), support rotation, and handle key revocation (if customer revokes key, stop future exports and surface errors to tenant).
maya: Proposed MVP scope (for prioritization):
- nightly immutable exports with signed manifest (golden path)
- API for on-demand export (best-effort, no hard SLA)
- support CMEK for export encryption
- Console toggles: immutability + legal_hold
Exclude: strict <4h full-export SLA, multi-region fallback, and per-tenant parallelism guarantees — v2 items.
sara: Launch acceptance criteria suggestion:
- security review completed and signed off
- e2e test: attempted remote-delete of an export must fail (WORM enforcement)
- KMS handshake integration tests (rotate/revoke flows)
- documented runbook for emergency exports and legal holds
- contract language drafted for export commitments
noah: I'll own CMEK handshake and revocation flows. I'll also draft threat model for key material lifecycle.
chris: Rough estimates: infra 3 sprints (priority queue + workers + observability), product 2 sprints (API + console), security review 1 sprint.
chris: Risks: tenants with >100TB; packaging time balloons, KMS throttling from many tenants, signing bottleneck.
maya: Metrics we should track pre-launch and in pilot:
- export_latency.p90
- export_failure_rate
- percent_exports_encrypted_with_customer_CMEK
- time_to_sign_manifest
Please add owners.
noah: I'll own CMEK metrics and revocation alerts.
sara: Legal review required for SLA language. Adding @legal to acceptance checklist. :+1:
chris: Draft config snippet proposal for product console/API:
```
export:
  schedule: nightly
  immutability: true
  retention_days: 2555  # 7 years
  encryption: cmek
  priority: \"on-demand|batch\"
```
maya: OK — moving to roadmap prioritization for Q3. I'll create the parent ticket and attach this thread + INF-4927. Will ping stakeholders after RFC. :eyes: :thumbsup:
noah: I'll create an RFC with flow diagrams and KMS handshake sequence today.
sara: I'll coordinate with legal for wording and compliance signoff.
chris: I'll scope infra tickets and add an initial load test plan.
maya: Thanks team — will follow up in the RFC thread.
